title: Distant relation to Jimmy Cheatham and mistaken identity with Dick Cheatham
summary: Albertson's Bessie book mistook him for pianist-bandleader Dick Cheatham, who is unrelated.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You're not related to Jimmy Cheatham are you?
We're sort of distant related, yeah.
You are. Now I made a mistake in my book on Bessie, apparently, I mentioned you in there, somebody told me they had spoken to you that it wasn't you, it was another Cheatham, I think, in Detroit --
You mean Ohio, that was Richard, Dick Cheatham.
He was a famous -- he was a pianist. He's the one that had that band.
And he was not related to you?
